# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 4 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 4
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Let us look carefully at what is happening now and search for what can save us. We must get completely away from every kind of lawlessness before it takes us over. We must reject the errors of this present age if we want to be welcomed in the age to come.
2. Let us not give our souls permission to run with the lawless and the sinful — we will end up just like them.
3. The great stumbling block is almost here. As Enoch writes about it: "The Master has cut the times and days short for this very reason — so that his Beloved could move quickly and come into his inheritance."
4. The prophet also says: "Ten kingdoms will rule the earth. After them a small king will rise up and crush three of the kingdoms at once."
5. Daniel says the same thing: "I saw the fourth beast — wicked, powerful, fiercer than all the other beasts of the earth — and ten horns rising from it, and then a small horn, and how it cut down three of the great horns at once."
6. So take notice. And I want to say something more — speaking as one of your own, someone who loves each of you more than myself: Watch yourselves now. Do not fall into the trap of those who pile sin on sin and say, "The covenant belongs to us and to them."
7. It belongs to us. They lost it permanently — and here is how: when Moses had already received it, scripture says: "Moses fasted on the mountain for forty days and forty nights and received the covenant from the Lord — stone tablets written by the finger of the Lord's own hand."
8. But they turned to idols and lost it. The Lord said: "Moses, Moses, come down right now — your people whom you brought out of Egypt have fallen into lawlessness." Moses understood. He threw the two tablets from his hands. Their covenant was shattered — so that the covenant of Jesus the Beloved could be sealed in our hearts, through hope in his faithfulness.
9. I want to write much more — not as your teacher, but as someone who loves you and wants to share everything we have. I have worked hard to write to you, even though I am only a poor servant. But hear me: we must be attentive in these last days.
10. The entire time we have held to our faith will count for nothing if we do not stand firm right now, in this lawless season, in the face of the stumbling blocks that are coming — as God's children must.
11. Give the Black One no opening. Flee everything empty. Hate the deeds that belong to the evil path, completely. Do not withdraw into yourself or live in isolation as though you have already arrived. Come together, discuss what matters most to you all.
12. The scripture says: "Woe to those who are clever in their own eyes and smart in their own estimation!" Let us become spiritual. Let us become a perfect temple for God. With everything in us, let us live in the fear of God, keep his commands, and rejoice in his righteous ways of judging.
